declaration.theory: strict linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity
declaration.radial_module: the certified complete six-dimensional Fourier-reduced Bach module with all three Ricci reconstruction rows
declaration.allowed_conjugacy: local invertible changes of reduced variables that are regular at the declared endpoint

exact_composition.typing: D_Ricci maps the reduced metric module to the trace-free divergence-free axial Ricci-carrier module; L_Ricci acts on that carrier
exact_composition.classification: exact two-factor operator composition, not an identified repeated scalar factor

dimension_obstruction.conclusion: No invertible conjugacy can identify the complete six-dimensional reduced Bach module with the four-dimensional local solution module of a scalar Regge-Wheeler square.
dimension_obstruction.spectral_derivative_ceiling: A scalar RW solution family has two local columns; adjoining one spectral derivative for each supplies at most two generalized columns, hence at most four columns including the original RW kernel and misses at least two certified Bach directions.

endpoint_obstruction.conclusion: The horizon exponent multiset is not the naively doubled Regge-Wheeler scalar multiset, so the carrier is not a direct duplicated-root copy of the RW module under a zero-weight regular endpoint identification. This is diagnostic rather than a general operator-square no-go: composing singular differential expressions can shift indicial roots. The scalar-square obstruction for the complete module rests on the invariant six-versus-four dimension mismatch. The doubled infinity rates alone are insufficient to infer a square because the carrier has two independent tensorial power columns at each rate.

matrix_factor_disposition.certified: The covariant composition L_Ricci o D_Ricci is exact.
matrix_factor_disposition.not_certified: No common reduced bundle, regular intertwiner, or equality of the two factors has been constructed, so an identical matrix-factor square is not established.
matrix_factor_disposition.regular_identical_factor_shortcut: not established; the certified factors have unequal typing, and no common three-component module or intertwiner has been produced
matrix_factor_disposition.arbitrary_matrix_square_equivalence: not classified; the endpoint exponents alone cannot exclude weighted singular compositions

spectral_and_time_derivatives.fixed_frequency_radial_sensitivity: For P(omega)u(omega)=0, partial_omega u satisfies P partial_omega u = -(partial_omega P)u. It is an inhomogeneous variational column and is not automatically a homogeneous Bach mode.
spectral_and_time_derivatives.scalar_spectral_parameter_case: If P(lambda)=P0+lambda and P(lambda)u(lambda)=0, then P partial_lambda u=-u and P^2 partial_lambda u=0. This constructs at most one generalized scalar partner per RW solution.
spectral_and_time_derivatives.radial_generalized_mode: A fixed-omega solution with polynomial or logarithmic radial behaviour still carries exp(i*omega*v), so time translation acts diagonally.
spectral_and_time_derivatives.genuine_time_Jordan_chain: Differentiating the complete spacetime mode gives partial_omega(exp(i*omega*v)u)=exp(i*omega*v)(i*v*u+partial_omega*u), and (partial_v-i*omega) of this vector equals i times the original mode.
spectral_and_time_derivatives.transport_warning: Taylor sensitivity columns used to validate frequency-correlated radial transport omit the i*v*u term and must not be counted as time-translation Jordan states or extra physical solutions.

legacy_radial_column.legacy_status: a degree-one, log-free radial generalized column of the incomplete two-row reconstruction
legacy_radial_column.complete_status: excluded from the complete six-dimensional module
legacy_radial_column.exact_reason: the omitted delta_Ric_vphi=P row has residual 3*i*(omega-2*i)/r^2, nonzero throughout the real pilot interval
legacy_radial_column.consequence: It is neither evidence for a scalar RW square nor a genuine time-translation Jordan chain.
